prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law
answer_verbatim:
I can give you a short list of reputable personal-injury firms that handle Houston car-wreck cases and explain why each is worth calling — plus what to ask and next steps. If you want phone numbers or firms closest to your crash location, tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and I’ll pull those details.

Firms to call (why)
- Morgan & Morgan — large national plaintiff firm with a Houston presence. Good if you want a firm with lots of resources to investigate crashes quickly, telltale experience with insurance negotiation, and a dedicated auto-accident practice.
- The Lanier Law Firm (Mark Lanier / Lanier trial attorneys) — Houston-based, high-profile plaintiff trial lawyers. Strong track record with high-value/complex injury cases and litigation experience if your claim may need a jury trial.
- Arnold & Itkin LLP — Houston plaintiffs’ firm known for fighting major and catastrophic injury claims (including big verdicts/settlements). Good choice if you or a loved one suffered serious or catastrophic injuries.
- The Cochran Firm (Houston office) — national name with local Houston presence and experience in auto-accident representation; often helpful if you want a recognizable firm that handles a high volume of injury matters.
Why these choices: they all have established plaintiff practices, handle auto-accident cases, and have the staffing and investigative resources to handle serious claims and litigate if needed. They typically offer free consultations and work on contingency (no upfront attorney fees; they take a percentage of recovery).

How to pick between them
- Match the firm to your case severity: small soft-tissue claims may be handled fine by a general PI firm; catastrophic injuries or complex liability disputes call for a boutique trial team.
- Verify trial experience and recent results for cases like yours.
- Check whether the lead attorney is Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law (Texas) or has relevant trial verdicts.
- Read client reviews and look up disciplinary history on the Texas Bar website.

Key questions to ask during the free consult
- Do you handle car-accident cases like mine? (ask for similar case examples)
- Who will handle day-to-day contact — partner, associate, paralegal?
- Do you take cases on contingency? What is the fee percentage and are there additional costs?
- Do you have experience taking cases to trial? What percentage settle vs. go to trial?
- Will you investigate the crash (accident reconstruction, medical experts)?
- How long do you expect my case to take and what are typical settlement ranges?
- What documents do you need from me now?

What to have ready when you call
- Crash date, location, brief description of what happened
- Names of parties, insurance information, police report number (if available)
- Photos of damages/injuries, medical treatment records or providers
- Any communications from insurance companies

If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood (I’ll find local offices and phone numbers)
- Brief facts about the crash and injuries (minor vs. catastrophic)
I’ll then provide 4–6 contact numbers for firms appropriate to your situation and a recommended first call order.
